name: Cronus
source:
Reckless, smug, violent and egotistical, Cronus believes his abilities place him above everyone else. Because of his overconfidence, he usually does not measure the consequences of his actions.

His dream is to establish his own cult and be worshipped.

"Every god needs a loyal servant."
